Duties:

- Thorough knowledge of GAGAS (Yellow Book), AICPA auditing standards, and SFFAS/SFFAS interpretation requirements for federal entities.
- Demonstrated proficiency in audit data analytics tools and proficiency-level Excel skills for testing large transaction populations.
- Ability to travel up to 40 percent of scheduled time to federal field locations and agency headquarters for on-site audit work.
